targets.root_selector: if .properties.nextLink then error("Cost response truncated; shorten time range") elif (.properties.rows|type)!="array" then error("Azure cost response unavailable") elif any(.properties.rows[];.[3]!="USD") then error("Unexpected Azure currency") else {Category:"Reported costs",amount:([.properties.rows[][0]]|add // 0)} end

if .properties.nextLink then error("Cost response truncated; shorten time range") elif (.properties.rows|type)!="array" then error("Azure cost response unavailable") elif any(.properties.rows[];.[3]!="USD") then error("Unexpected Azure currency") else {Category:"Reported costs",amount:([.properties.rows[][0]]|add // 0)} end

if (.jobComplete != true) then error("Billing query is still running; refresh later") elif .pageToken then error("Billing result truncated; shorten time range") elif any(.rows[]?;.f[6].v!="SGD") then error("Unexpected GCP currency") else [.rows[]? | .f[3].v | select(.!=null) | tonumber] as $costs | {Category:"Reported costs",GCP:(if ($costs|length)>0 then ($costs|add) else null end),GCPStatus:(if ($costs|length)>0 then "Available" else "Unavailable (not zero)" end)} end

def sgdate: sub("\\.[0-9]+Z$";"Z")|fromdateiso8601|.+28800|strftime("%d %b %Y"); if .errors then error(.errors|tostring) elif .data.workspace.customer.currentUsage==null then error("Railway usage unavailable") else .data.workspace.customer | {Category:"Reported costs",RailwayUSD:.currentUsage,RailwayCycle:((.billingPeriod.start|sgdate)+" - "+(.billingPeriod.end|sgdate))} end

if .base!="USD" or .quote!="SGD" or (.rate|type)!="number" or .rate<=0 then error("Invalid USD/SGD reference rate") elif (now-(.date+"T00:00:00Z"|fromdateiso8601))>604800 then error("FX reference older than seven days") else {Category:"Reported costs",FX:.rate,FXDate:.date} end

panels.title: Railway · workspace usage · current billing cycle
Railway · billing period and accrued usage

options.content: The **accrued USD** total is the official current-cycle amount. The resource breakdown below is an estimate from billed usage units and published rates; its hourly-sampled daily chart estimates CPU, RAM and volume only for the selected dates within the current cycle. These estimates can differ from the official total. Plan fees, included usage and credits remain on the provider invoice. [Open Railway usage](https://railway.com/workspace/usage).
